assessment:
Skill invoked: `ariakit-general-workflow` (remote is `github.com/ariakit/visonaut`; no Visonaut-specific skill is installed). I read the coverage summary, the reports and verification files on disk, the nine second-lens checks, and the repository tree. **Verdict.** Coverage of the dashboard load path is saturated. Seven lanes found the Better Auth schema check, five counted the D1 round trips, and the second-lens checks fixed the numbers. No new lane is necessary there. Coverage is thin in five areas. Each one is a subsystem or a claim that no lane examined.

2. **Nobody looked at the system from the consumer repository.** Real data is public. Example for one `main` commit of `ariakit/ariakit`:

   ```text

   Visonaut (app visonaut-ci) started 16:55:23, completed 19:26:20, "Visual review passed"
   ```

   The service also pins the consumer workflow file by blob SHA:

   ```ts
   // packages/security/src/oidc.ts:171
   requireEqual(file.sha, sha(configuration.callerWorkflowBlobSha), "rest.caller_workflow_blob");
   ```

   `git log -G"reusableWorkflowSha|VISONAUT_TRUSTED_EXECUTOR_DIGEST" -- apps/web/wrangler.jsonc` lists 36 commits in 12 days. No lane reported this coupling, and OPS-01, OPS-11, API-03, PKG-01 have no production incidence.

The auth verifier measured three facts that are in no finding (`audit/auth/verification.md:361-392`): `get-access-token` returns the plaintext GitHub user token, sign-in is open to all GitHub accounts, and `requireSameOrigin` trusts a header.

The API lane left "the service write transactions" out. State bugs were found only by accident (PKG-07, OPS-01, API-03).
5. **R2 has no map.** D1 growth is covered; object storage is not. Example: `/** Keep sparse review inventories after their original images expire. */` (`apps/web/src/operations/retention.ts:46`). The production database is 1 to 2 days old and the byte window is 30 days (`packages/service/src/work.ts:695`), so the deletion paths have not run on the current storage form.

**Considered and not requested.** A GitHub rate-limit lane (`second-lens-5.md` already covers the check chain). A cost model (it needs account analytics).
